eq-classification-rates-as-integrals.title: Classification Rates as Integrals
tex: TPR(T) = \int_T^{\infty} f_p(x)\, dx \qquad FNR(T) = \int_{-\infty}^{T} f_p(x)\, dx
TNR(T) = \int_{-\infty}^{T} f_n(x)\, dx \qquad FPR(T) = \int_T^{\infty} f_n(x)\, dx

eq-bm25-over-postings.title: BM25 over postings

eq-proximity-score.title: Proximity Score
tex: \text{score}_{\text{prox}}(Q, D) = \sum_{i=1}^{m} \text{bin}_i(Q, D) \cdot w_i \qquad \text{with } w_1 > w_2 > \ldots > w_m

eq-bm25f.title: BM25F
tex: \text{sim}_{\text{BM25F}}(Q, D) = \sum_{t \in Q} \text{idf}(t) \cdot \frac{\widetilde{\text{tf}}(t, D) \cdot (k_1 + 1)}{\widetilde{\text{tf}}(t, D) + k_1 \cdot \left(1 - b + b \cdot \frac{|D|}{\text{avgdl}}\right)}

eq-pairwise-logistic-loss-ranknet.title: Pairwise Logistic Loss (RankNet)
